Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.36 (vs ₹4.98 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.36 (up from ₹4.98 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹272.1b (up 308% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹70.1b (up 7.8% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 26% (down from 97% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is expected to decline by 57% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, while revenues in the Diversified Financial industry in India are expected to grow by 15%. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 5% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 43% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Indian Railway Finance broadly unchanged around ₹64.0, with only minor tweaks to inputs such as the discount rate and forward P/E assumptions to reflect updated risk and valuation models. What's in the News On March 9, the board approved a second interim dividend of ₹1.05 per equity share of ₹10 each for FY 2025-26, with March 13 set as the record date and payment expected within 30 days to eligible shareholders (Key Developments).

news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Indian Railway Finance steady at ₹64. Only minor tweaks to inputs such as discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E guidance have informed this unchanged price target.

news.title: IRFC: Government Stake Sale At ₹104 Will Pressure Overvalued Shares
news.body: Analysts have modestly adjusted their price target for Indian Railway Finance, keeping fair value steady at ₹64 as small tweaks to the discount rate and forward P/E assumptions fine tune their outlook rather than signal a major shift in view. What's in the News The government plans to sell up to a 4% stake in Indian Railway Finance Corporation via an offer for sale, with a base 2% equity divestment and an additional 2% green shoe option.

news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹1.05. Ex-date: 13th March 2026 Payment date: 8th April 2026 Dividend yield will be 2.1%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.3%. Sustainability & Growth The dividend has remained flat since 5 years ago. However, payments have been volatile during that time.

news.title: IRFC: Upcoming Government Stake Sale Will Likely Pressure Overvalued Shares
news.body: Analysts now set their price target for Indian Railway Finance at ₹64, up from ₹60, citing updated inputs for discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and forward P/E in their refreshed valuation work. What's in the News The government plans to sell up to a 4% stake in Indian Railway Finance Corporation through an offer for sale, with 2% equity on offer and an additional 2% as a green shoe option, at a floor price of ₹104 per share.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.38 (vs ₹1.25 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.38 (up from ₹1.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹18.5b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹18.0b (up 11% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 98% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 4% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 53% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
